question: Which of the following instruments is used to decipher indented writings?
explanation: ESDA is the standard instrument for visualising indented writing on the sheets beneath a written page, using electrostatic charge and toner.
reel_explain: ESDA (Electrostatic Detection Apparatus) reveals indented writing on the pages below a written sheet, using electrostatic charge and toner.

question: Washerwoman's skin appears in:
explanation: Pale, wrinkled, sodden skin on the palms and soles is a classic finding in bodies recovered after prolonged immersion in water.
reel_explain: Pale, wrinkled, sodden skin on palms and soles: a classic sign of a body kept long in water. It also helps estimate how long it was submerged.
source: From FACToids of Forensic Biological Sciences · Q83

question: Which of the following viruses evade detection by using a sophisticated form of encryption?
explanation: A polymorphic virus changes/encrypts its own code each time it replicates, so its signature never looks the same twice.
reel_explain: A polymorphic virus encrypts its own code differently on every infection, so its signature never looks the same twice.
source: From NET-Cracker Module 9 · Digital & Cyber Forensics (free)

question: Cherry red coloration of hypostasis is seen in:
explanation: Carbon monoxide binds haemoglobin far more strongly than oxygen, forming bright-red carboxyhaemoglobin that colours the pooled blood.
reel_explain: CO binds haemoglobin far more strongly than oxygen, forming bright-red carboxyhaemoglobin, so post-mortem lividity turns cherry red.
source: From FACToids of Forensic Biological Sciences · Q82
